name: Sail Away
source:
Set sail in this short visual novel that takes you on an emotional adventure across the seven seas. Get to know your crew, make friends or enemies, fall in love, and much more as you raise the mast and Sail Away!

[From [url=https://writer31.itch.io/sail-away]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这部短篇视觉小说中扬帆起航，踏上横跨七大洋的动人冒险之旅吧！深入了解你的船员伙伴，结交挚友或树敌交锋，邂逅真挚恋情——升起主桅、乘风远航，还有更多精彩等待着你！

[摘自[url=https://writer31.itch.io/sail-away]itch.io[/url]]
